chapter: Early bands around Bay St. Louis
title: Territory played and the Sosia family band
summary: The bands worked from Bay St. Louis to Biloxi and Kiln; August Sosia led a family band with his children, and bands played halls, not picnics or ball games.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
